description: This file defines the EmpEmergencyContactDecorator class, which adds additional behavior or decorations to the EmpEmergencyContact entity, including setting its associated Employee via an employee number. It is part of a Human Resource Management system, specifically within the Employee Emergency Contact context, and employs traits for ORM assistance.

classes.name: EmpEmergencyContactDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class for the EmpEmergencyContact entity, providing methods to link an employee based on employee number.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with an EmpEmergencyContact entity instance.

methods.name: getEmpEmergencyContact
methods.description: Returns the wrapped EmpEmergencyContact entity instance.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity to the emergency contact based on the provided employee number.
